fixer.title: agentHost: centralize session and chat catalog metadata

introducer.title: agentHost: make the orchestrator own session enumeration and chat lifecycle

cases.mechanism: Every list computation opened each visible session's separate SQLite database and read a broad metadata object, creating filesystem/SQLite fan-out proportional to the catalog size even when entries were unchanged.
cases.symptom: The old code explicitly described catalog listing as slow because it opened every registered session database and emitted slow-list timing when this path exceeded the threshold.
cases.fixedBehavior: The added catalog-reader call serves eligible rows from the central `sessions_v2` database and only sends missing, stale, or invalid rows through the legacy per-session fallback, removing steady-state per-session database opens.
cases.evidence: The deleted overlay mapped every listed session through `tryOpenDatabase(s.session)` and `getMetadataObject(...)`; the added path at line 2794 reads the central catalog projection under concurrency 4, returns eligible metadata directly, and reserves `_legacyRegisteredSessionMetadata` for ineligible rows. The base line carrying the unconditional per-session open blames to the supplied introducing commit.
